values.note: City of Petoskey 2026: electric-only $35 a night non-peak, $45 peak (Memorial Day to Labor Day); full hookup $40 / $50. $8 transaction fee on all reservations. One rate for everyone (no resident rate). Dump station $10 for non-campers.

values.note: Request online on the city's Bookmysites page; phone calls go to voicemail and are returned in 24-72 hours. Reservations open in stages by length of stay - 90 nights or more first, then 30 or more, then any length; the 2027 dates are TBD. A cancellation one or more days ahead costs 20%.

note: City of Petoskey municipal campground on Little Traverse Bay at the end of West Lake St (901 W Lake St), with 1,000 ft of shoreline: about 36 full-hookup and 39 water/electric sites plus cabins, and a beach; walkable to Bayfront Park, the Little Traverse Wheelway and downtown. Open ~May 2-Oct 11. --Claude
